entities.name: Alois, Prince of Schönburg-Hartenstein
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prince Alois Schönburg-Hartenstein was a military officer in the Austro-Hungarian army and as a Prince of Schönburg-Hartenstein, a member of the high Austrian nobility. He briefly served from March to July 1934 as Minister of Defense of the First Austrian Republic.

entities.summary: Prince Alois Schönburg-Hartenstein was a military officer in the Austro-Hungarian army and as a Prince of Schönburg-Hartenstein, a member of the high Austrian nobility. He briefly served from March to July 1934 as Minister of Defense of the First Austrian Republic.
